g.text: Partially permeable; controls what enters and leaves
Jelly-like; where many chemical reactions happen
Holds genetic material; controls the cell's activities
Site of aerobic respiration; releases energy
Cellulose; gives the cell shape and support
Has chlorophyll; absorbs light for photosynthesis
Large, fluid-filled; keeps the cell firm (turgid)
Cell wall and a regular (fixed) shape
Animal cells: no cell wall or chloroplasts; only small, temporary vacuoles.
